title: Dad's Italian Chicken
description: A family notebook recipe for chicken, sweet peppers, onion, and cherry tomatoes in a honey and Italian dressing marinade, finished with apple cider vinegar.
cookTime: About 15 minutes in a skillet; about 45 minutes in the oven
ingredients: 454 g boneless chicken breast, cut into strips
3 small sweet peppers (about 120 g total), diced
21 g Penzeys Italian Dressing Base (about 2 tablespoons; approximate weight)
steps: Cut the chicken into strips. Dice the onion and sweet peppers.
In a bowl, combine the chicken, peppers, onion, and garlic. Add the Italian Dressing Base, honey, and cherry tomatoes. Mix until coated.
Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours.
For the skillet method, heat a frying pan and add the oil. Stir the apple cider vinegar into the chicken mixture, then add it to the hot pan.
Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring as needed, until the chicken reaches 165°F / 74°C. Serve with salad, rice, or noodles.

For the oven alternative, heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C. Add the vinegar to the marinated mixture and place it in a covered baking dish. Bake for about 45 minutes, checking for 165°F / 74°C in the chicken. Uncover, broil for 3–5 minutes, and serve hot or cold.
notes: Transcribed from Dad's handwritten recipe. The seasoning, onion, and pepper weights are approximate conversions from 2 tablespoons, 1 onion, and 3 small peppers; adjust to the produce on hand. The original calls for 2 tablespoons Penzeys Italian Dressing Base, 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, and 1 tablespoon minced garlic. Its oven alternative specifies 350°F, about 45 minutes covered, then 3–5 minutes under the broiler.
